title: Performance Budgets for Marketing and App Routes
excerpt: Marketing pages and authenticated app shells fail for different reasons, but they share one rule: without budgets, every launch adds weight until search and conversion quietly suffer.
description: How staff engineers set per-route performance budgets, wire them to CI, and keep marketing and product surfaces inside measurable LCP and INP guardrails.

sections.heading: Templates need their own budgets
paragraphs: Landing pages compete on first paint; dashboards compete on interaction readiness. A single global bundle budget hides which team regressed which surface.
Split budgets by route class and third-party tag ownership so marketing experiments do not inherit engineering defaults.
Marketing hero assets and authenticated dashboards rarely share the same bottleneck—split budgets so one team cannot spend another's latency.

sections.heading: Ship perf with the release train
paragraphs: Attach budget checks to preview deployments for high-traffic templates. Block merges that blow LCP without an explicit waiver tied to an owner.
Roll back feature flags when INP crosses thresholds in canary, not after a week of complaints.
Attach budget regressions to the same rollback conversation as error-rate spikes.

Tie perf regressions to release trains and rollback rules

Publish perf dashboards beside error rate for product

sections.heading: Test slow networks deliberately
paragraphs: Lab tests on fast laptops lie. Run smoke perf on representative mobile profiles and cache states.
Track hero image bytes, font loading strategy, and hydration cost as first-class metrics.
Synthetic checks from three regions catch CDN and DNS issues that lab Wi-Fi hides.

sections.heading: Make perf visible to product
paragraphs: Product managers should see perf trends next to conversion, not in a quarterly infra review.
Budgets are how you keep SEO and UX from becoming a postmortem theme.
Perf is a feature: publish weekly trends to product leads, not only to frontend guild channels.

sections.heading: Split budgets by traffic class
paragraphs: Marketing landing pages and authenticated application shells rarely share the same critical path. Assign separate performance budgets for static hero routes, logged-in dashboards, and API-backed widgets so one team's experiment cannot consume another team's latency envelope. Document owners in the same service catalog entry you use for on-call routing.

Budgets should name the metric, the percentile, and the geography. A p75 Largest Contentful Paint target in Frankfurt does not transfer to São Paulo without CDN evidence. Tie regressions to deployment metadata so you can distinguish bundle growth from upstream saturation or DNS misconfiguration during cutovers.

Review budget burn in product forums, not only frontend guild meetings. When product managers see weekly trend lines beside feature velocity, they negotiate scope before shipping another carousel or third-party tag manager snippet. Performance becomes a planning input instead of a post-release fire drill. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

sections.heading: Instrument against documented baselines
paragraphs: Synthetic monitors and lab Lighthouse runs disagree when authentication, feature flags, or consent banners differ from production. Align probes with real client headers, cookie policies, and edge caching rules your marketing stack actually emits. Otherwise budgets green-light merges that fail under real user conditions. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

Use HTTP caching semantics deliberately on marketing assets while keeping hashed filenames immutable. Misapplied Cache-Control on HTML shells creates stale campaign messaging; overly short TTL on static chunks recreates unnecessary origin load. RFC guidance helps engineers argue with ad-tech vendors using shared vocabulary. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

Publish which budgets gate merges versus which only page owners. Hard gates belong on routes that drive revenue or signup completion; informational budgets can warn on editorial pages without blocking the train. Clarity prevents alert fatigue and keeps rollback conversations focused on user-visible regressions. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

sections.heading: Shared budgets without blame shifting
paragraphs: Marketing landing routes and authenticated app shells rarely share bottlenecks, yet teams fight over one global Lighthouse score. Publish separate budgets for static hero pages, localized campaigns, and logged-in dashboards, each with owner and allowed third-party scripts. Regressions attach to the same rollback conversation as error-rate spikes, so product managers cannot treat perf as a frontend hobby. Budget dashboards should trend weekly, not only alarm on deploy day.

Real-user monitoring fills gaps synthetics miss—login flows, paywalls, and geo-specific CDN paths—but sample rates must respect privacy tags on events. Pair RUM with synthetic checks from three regions to catch DNS and edge misconfigurations lab Wi-Fi hides. When budgets breach, require a named mitigation: defer noncritical A/B scripts, shrink hero video, or paginate heavy tables, not vague tech debt tickets without dates.

Budgets fail when assets ship outside the main release train. Creative teams uploading five megabyte PNGs into CMS bypass CI unless upload hooks enforce compression and format rules. Block merges that add render-blocking tags without performance review on marketing routes. Document exceptions with expiry and measure whether conversions actually improved, otherwise revert the heavy asset after the campaign ends.

Staff engineers should facilitate quarterly budget reviews with marketing, growth, and mobile leads together. Compare p75 interaction to next paint on top campaigns against core task completion routes. Celebrate teams that renegotiate vendor contracts for lighter embeds. Performance is a product feature; publish trends where leadership sees them, not only in guild Slack channels engineers already inhabit.

sections.heading: Suçu başkasına atmadan ortak bütçeler
paragraphs: Pazarlama landing route'ları ile oturum açmış app shell'leri nadiren aynı darboğazı paylaşır ama ekipler tek global Lighthouse skoru için kavga eder. Statik hero, lokal kampanya ve giriş yapılmış dashboard için ayrı bütçe yayınlayın; her birinde owner ve izinli üçüncü parti script olsun. Regresyonlar error-rate spike ile aynı rollback konuşmasına bağlansın; PM'ler perf'i frontend hobi sayamasın. Bütçe panoları haftalık trend göstersin, yalnızca deploy günü alarm vermesin.

RUM sentetiğin kaçırdığı login, paywall ve bölgesel CDN yollarını doldurur; örnekleme oranları olaylardaki privacy etiketlerine uymalı. Bütçe aşımında adlı mitigasyon şart: kritik olmayan A/B script erteleme, hero video küçültme veya ağır tablo sayfalama; tarihsiz tech debt ticket değil. Sahip, gözden geçirme tarihi ve rollback tetikleyicisini aynı değişiklik ticket'ında kaydedin; sonraki on-call mühendis olayı yeniden açmadan kararları izleyebilsin.

Pazarlama route'larına render-blocking tag ekleyen merge'leri perf review olmadan bloklayın. İstisnaları süreli belgeleyin; dönüşüm gerçekten artmadıysa kampanya bitince ağır varlığı geri alın. Staff mühendisler pazarlama, growth ve mobil liderlerle çeyreklik bütçe review'u kolaylaştırsın. En iyi kampanyalarda p75 INP'yi çekirdek görev tamamlama route'larıyla karşılaştırın. Daha hafif embed için vendor sözleşmesi yenileyen ekipleri öne çıkarın. Performans ürün özelliğidir; trendleri yalnızca mühendis Slack'inde değil liderliğin gördüğü yerde yayınlayın. paragraphs: Check budget su preview deploy per template ad alto traffico. Bloccare merge che rompono LCP senza waiver con owner.
Rollback feature flag quando INP supera soglia in canary.
points: Budget LCP/INP per template, non solo globali
Collegare regressioni perf a release train e rollback
Smoke su dispositivi reali e reti lente in CI
Dashboard perf visibili al prodotto accanto al tasso errori

sections.heading: Testare deliberatamente reti lente
paragraphs: I test lab su laptop veloci mentono. Smoke perf su profili mobile e stati cache.
Byte hero, font e costo hydration come metriche first-class.

sections.heading: Rendere la perf visibile al prodotto
paragraphs: Il prodotto vede trend perf accanto alla conversione.
I budget evitano che SEO e UX diventino tema del postmortem.

links.label: Google Search Central — Core Web Vitals

sections.heading: Separare i budget per classe di traffico
paragraphs: Landing marketing e shell applicative autenticate condividono raramente lo stesso critical path. Assegnate budget performance distinti a route hero statiche, dashboard loggati e widget API così un esperimento di team non consuma l'envelope di latenza di un altro. Documentate gli owner nella stessa voce catalogo servizi usata per il routing on-call.

I budget devono nominare metrica, percentile e geografia. Un obiettivo LCP p75 a Francoforte non si trasferisce a San Paolo senza evidenza CDN. Collegate le regressioni ai metadati di deploy per separare crescita del bundle da saturazione upstream o DNS errato durante i cutover. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

Rivedete il consumo budget nei forum prodotto, non solo nella guild frontend. Quando i PM vedono trend settimanali accanto alla velocity feature, negoziano scope prima di shipparre un altro carosello o snippet tag manager. La performance diventa input di pianificazione, non drill post-release. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

sections.heading: Strumentare rispetto a baseline documentate
paragraphs: Monitor sintetici e Lighthouse da lab divergono se auth, feature flag o banner consenso differiscono dalla prod. Allineate le sonde a header client, policy cookie e regole edge cache che lo stack marketing emette davvero. Altrimenti i budget approvano merge che falliscono in condizioni utente reali.

Usate deliberatamente la semantica HTTP cache sugli asset marketing mantenendo nomi hash immutabili. Cache-Control errato sulle shell HTML crea messaggi campagna obsoleti; TTL troppo breve su chunk statici ricarica l'origine inutilmente. La guida RFC aiuta a discutere con vendor ad-tech in vocabolario condiviso. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

Pubblicate quali budget bloccano merge e quali paginano solo gli owner. Gate duri appartengono a route revenue o completamento signup; budget informativi possono avvisare su pagine editoriali senza fermare il train. Chiarezza riduce alert fatigue e concentra rollback su regressioni visibili. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

sections.heading: Budget condivisi senza scaricabarile
paragraphs: Landing marketing e shell app autenticate raramente condividono colli di bottiglia, eppure i team litigano su un unico Lighthouse globale. Budget separati per hero statiche, campagne localizzate e dashboard loggati, ciascuno con owner e script third-party ammessi. Regressioni nella stessa conversazione rollback dei picchi error rate; i PM non trattino perf come hobby frontend. Dashboard budget in trend settimanale, non solo allarme deploy.

RUM colma login, paywall, percorsi CDN geo—sample rate rispettano tag privacy. RUM più synthetic da tre regioni per DNS ed edge nascosti dal Wi-Fi lab. Sforamento budget richiede mitigazione nominata: rimandare script A/B, ridurre video hero, paginare tabelle pesanti—niente ticket tech debt senza data. Registrate owner, data di review e trigger di rollback nello stesso ticket di change così il prossimo on-call engineer rintraccia le decisioni senza riaprire l'incident.

I budget falliscono quando asset shippano fuori dal release train. Creative che caricano PNG da 5 MB nel CMS bypassano CI senza hook compressione. Bloccare merge con tag render-blocking su route marketing senza review perf. Eccezioni con scadenza; senza miglior conversione, revert asset pesante a fine campagna. Registrate owner, data di review e trigger di rollback nello stesso ticket di change così il prossimo on-call engineer rintraccia le decisioni senza riaprire l'incident.

Staff engineer facilitano review trimestrali con marketing, growth e mobile lead. Confrontare p75 INP campagne top vs route completamento task core. Celebrare team che rinegoziano vendor per embed più leggeri. Performance è feature prodotto; pubblicare trend dove guarda la leadership, non solo Slack di guild. Registrate owner, data di review e trigger di rollback nello stesso ticket di change così il prossimo on-call engineer rintraccia le decisioni senza riaprire l'incident.

zh.title: 营销与应用路由的性能预算
zh.excerpt: 营销页与认证应用壳失败原因不同；无预算则每次发布增重，搜索与转化悄然受损。
zh.description: 按路由设性能预算、接入 CI，并用可测 LCP/INP 护栏约束营销与产品面。

sections.heading: 模板需要独立预算
paragraphs: 落地页争首屏，仪表盘争交互就绪；单一全局 bundle 预算掩盖谁回归。
按路由类型与第三方标签归属拆分预算。

sections.heading: 与发布列车一起交付性能
paragraphs: 高流量模板预览部署挂预算检查；LCP 爆表 merge 无明确豁免则阻断。
金丝雀 INP 越阈即回滚 feature flag。
points: 按模板而非仅全局预算 LCP/INP
将性能回归绑定发布列车与回滚规则
CI 冒烟在真机与慢网上测量
与错误率并列向产品展示性能看板

sections.heading: 刻意测试慢网络
paragraphs: 快笔记本实验室测试会撒谎；在代表移动配置与缓存态跑冒烟性能。
Hero 字节、字体策略与水合成本为一等指标。

sections.heading: 让产品看见性能
paragraphs: 产品经理应在转化旁看到性能趋势。
预算避免 SEO 与 UX 成为复盘主题。

links.label: Google Search Central — Core Web Vitals

sections.heading: 按流量类型拆分预算
paragraphs: 营销落地页与已登录应用壳层很少共享同一关键路径。为静态 hero 路由、登录仪表盘与 API 小组件分别设定性能预算，避免一个团队的实验耗尽另一团队的延迟额度。在与 on-call 路由相同的服务目录条目中记录负责人。
预算应写明指标、分位数与地域。p75 LCP 目标在法兰克福成立，不代表圣保罗无需 CDN 证据。将回归关联部署元数据，以区分 bundle 膨胀、上游饱和与切换期 DNS 误配。
在产品评审而非仅前端例会中查看预算消耗。PM 在功能速度与周趋势并列时，会在再上加 carousel 或第三方 tag manager 前协商范围。性能成为规划输入，而非发布后救火。

sections.heading: 对照文档化基线做观测
paragraphs: 当认证、特性开关或同意横幅与生产不一致时，合成监控与实验室 Lighthouse 会分歧。探针应对齐营销栈实际发送的客户端头、Cookie 策略与边缘缓存规则。否则预算会为真实用户条件下失败的合并开绿灯。
营销资源 deliberate 使用 HTTP 缓存语义，同时保持哈希文件名不可变。HTML 壳层 Cache-Control 误用会导致活动文案过期；静态 chunk TTL 过短则徒增源站负载。RFC 指引帮助工程师与 ad-tech 厂商用共同词汇讨论。
公开哪些预算阻断合并、哪些仅 paging 负责人。硬门禁应放在收入或注册完成路径；告知性预算可在编辑页告警而不阻断发布列车。清晰边界减少告警疲劳，使回滚讨论聚焦用户可见回归。

sections.heading: 共享性能预算而不互相甩锅
paragraphs: 营销落地页与已登录应用壳层很少共用瓶颈，团队却为一个全局 Lighthouse 分数争执。为静态 hero、本地化活动与登录仪表盘分别发布预算，各有负责人与允许的第三方脚本。回归与错误率尖峰纳入同一回滚讨论，产品经理不能把性能当作前端爱好。预算仪表盘应每周展示趋势，而非仅在发布日告警。 在同一变更工单中记录负责人、评审日期与回滚触发条件，以便下一轮值班工程师无需重开事件即可追溯决策。

真实用户监控填补合成监测盲区——登录、付费墙与区域 CDN——采样率须遵守事件隐私标签。结合三地区合成检查以发现实验室 Wi-Fi 掩盖的 DNS 与边缘配置错误。超预算须指名缓解措施：推迟非关键 A/B 脚本、缩小 hero 视频或分页重表，而非无日期的技术债工单。 在同一变更工单中记录负责人、评审日期与回滚触发条件，以便下一轮值班工程师无需重开事件即可追溯决策。 在同一变更工单中记录负责人、评审日期与回滚触发条件，以便下一轮值班工程师无需重开事件即可追溯决策。

资产在主发布列车之外上线时预算易失效。创意团队向 CMS 上传五兆 PNG 会在无上传钩子强制压缩时绕过 CI。阻止在营销路由添加阻塞渲染标签且未经性能评审的合并。例外须注明过期并衡量转化是否真提升，否则活动结束后回滚重资源。 在同一变更工单中记录负责人、评审日期与回滚触发条件，以便下一轮值班工程师无需重开事件即可追溯决策。 在同一变更工单中记录负责人、评审日期与回滚触发条件，以便下一轮值班工程师无需重开事件即可追溯决策。

Staff 工程师应每季度与营销、增长与移动端负责人联合评审预算。对比头部活动的 p75 INP 与核心任务完成路径。表彰重新谈判供应商以获得更轻嵌入的团队。性能是产品能力；趋势应发布到领导可见处，而非仅工程师频道。 在同一变更工单中记录负责人、评审日期与回滚触发条件，以便下一轮值班工程师无需重开事件即可追溯决策。 在同一变更工单中记录负责人、评审日期与回滚触发条件，以便下一轮值班工程师无需重开事件即可追溯决策。

ja.title: マーケティングとアプリルートのパフォーマンス予算
ja.excerpt: マーケページと認証アプリシェルは別理由で失敗する。予算なしではローンチのたびに重くなり検索とコンバージョンが静かに損なわれる。
ja.description: ルート別予算、CI連携、測定可能なLCP/INPガードレールでマーケとプロダクト面を守る。

sections.heading: テンプレートごとに予算
paragraphs: LPはファーストペイント、ダッシュボードは操作の準備。単一グローバルbundle予算は誰が悪化したか隠す。
ルートクラスとタグ所有者で予算を分割。

sections.heading: リリース列車と一緒にperfを出荷
paragraphs: 高トラフィックテンプレのプレビューに予算チェック。LCP破壊mergeはオーナー付き免除なしでブロック。
カナリアでINP閾値超えならフラグをロールバック。
points: LCP/INPをグローバルだけでなくテンプレート単位で予算化
Perf回帰をリリーストレインとロールバックに結び付け
CIスモークで実機と遅いネットワークを計測
エラー率の横にプロダクト向けPerfダッシュボード

sections.heading: 遅いネットを意図的に試す
paragraphs: 速いノートPCのラボは嘘をつく。代表モバイルプロファイルとキャッシュでスモークperf。
ヒーロー画像、フォント、ハイドレーションコストを第一級指標に。

sections.heading: プロダクトにperfを見える化
paragraphs: PMはコンバージョン横にperfトレンドを見るべき。
予算はSEO/UXがポストモーテム題材になるのを防ぐ。

links.label: Google Search Central — Core Web Vitals

sections.heading: トラフィッククラスごとに予算を分割
paragraphs: マーケ LP と認証済みアプリシェルは同じクリティカルパスを共有しにくい。静的 hero ルート、ログイン後ダッシュボード、API ウィジェットで性能予算を分け、一チームの実験が他チームのレイテンシ枠を食い尽くさないようにする。on-call ルーティングと同じサービスカタログ項目にオーナーを記載する。
予算は指標、パーセンタイル、地域を明示する。フランクフルトの p75 LCP 目標は CDN 根拠なしにサンパウロへは移植できない。回帰はデプロイメタデータに結び、バンドル増大とカットオーバー時の upstream 飽和や DNS 誤設定を切り分ける。
予算消費はフロントエンドギルドだけでなくプロダクトフォーラムでレビューする。PM が機能速度の横に週次トレンドを見れば、追加カルーセルや tag manager スニペット前にスコープ交渉が起きる。性能は計画入力となり、リリース後の火消しではなくなる。

sections.heading: 文書化ベースラインに沿って計測
paragraphs: 認証、feature flag、同意バナーが本番と異なると合成監視と lab Lighthouse は乖離する。プローブをマーケスタックが実際に出すクライアントヘッダ、Cookie 方針、エッジキャッシュ規則に合わせる。さもなければ予算が実ユーザー条件で失敗する merge を通してしまう。
マーケアセットでは HTTP キャッシュ意味論を意図的に使い、ハッシュファイル名は不変に保つ。HTML シェルの Cache-Control 誤りは古いキャンペーン文言を固定し、静的 chunk の短 TTL は origin 負荷を増やすだけだ。RFC ガイドは ad-tech ベンダーとの共通語彙議論に役立つ。
どの予算が merge を止め、どれが owner ページングのみかを公開する。ハードゲートは収益や signup 完了ルートに置く。情報的予算は編集ページで警告しつつトレインは止められる。明確さがアラート疲労を減らし、ロールバック議論をユーザー可視回帰に集中させる。

sections.heading: 責任押し付けなしの共有バジェット
paragraphs: マーケ landing と認証済み app shell はボトルネックを共有しにくいのに、単一 Lighthouse スコアで争います。静的 hero、ローカルキャンペーン、ログインダッシュボードで別バジェットを公開し、各 owner と許可 third-party script を明記。回帰は error spike と同じ rollback 会話に載せ、PM が perf を frontend 趣味扱いしない。バジェットダッシュボードは deploy 日だけでなく週次トレンド。

RUM は login、ペイウォール、地域 CDN など synthetic の穴を埋めますが、サンプル率は privacy タグを尊重。三地域 synthetic と RUM で lab Wi-Fi が隠す DNS・edge 誤設定を捕捉。超過時は named mitigation：非クリティカル A/B 延期、hero 動画縮小、重い表のページング—日付なし tech debt チケット禁止。 担当者、レビュー日、ロールバック条件を同一変更チケットに記録し、次の on-call エンジニアがインシデントを再オープンせず判断を追跡できるようにする。

release train 外で asset が ship するとバジェットは破綻。CMS に 5MB PNG を上げるクリエイティブは圧縮 hook なしで CI  bypass。マーケ route に render-blocking タグを足す merge を perf review なしで block。例外は失効付きで文書化し、コンバージョン改善がなければキャンペーン後に重 asset を revert。 担当者、レビュー日、ロールバック条件を同一変更チケットに記録し、次の on-call エンジニアがインシデントを再オープンせず判断を追跡できるようにする。

Staff engineer がマーケ・growth・モバイルリードと四半期バジェット review を進行。トップキャンペーンの p75 INP をコアタスク完了 route と比較。軽い embed の vendor 再交渉を称賛。パフォーマンスはプロダクト機能；トレンドは guild Slack だけでなくリーダーシップが見る場所へ。 担当者、レビュー日、ロールバック条件を同一変更チケットに記録し、次の on-call エンジニアがインシデントを再オープンせず判断を追跡できるようにする。
